messages:
maria: Quick heads-up: we plan to remove legacy signer header fallback (X-Redwood-Signer: v1) on 2026-05-10. This impacts partner SDKs and marketplace images that haven't picked up the v2 header. Need a short compatibility plan.
nana: tagging @liz @jiho. Which marketplace artifacts are most at risk? images, cli, installer bundles?
jiho: server patch is tinywe'll drop the fallback in gateway auth. Effect: old clients that send only v1 will get 401. SDKs >=v2.3 will send v2 already.
liz: Marketplace note: a fair number of vendor images pin SDK runtime. We'll run an automated scan and mark affected listings. Want to display a "compatibility advisory" badge and schedule rebuilds.
sam: Ops proposal: 2-week deprecation notice, 72h canary at 10% traffic, gateway feature-flag to re-enable fallback for rollback. I'll own the canary runbook.
jiho: Draft SDK blurb for partners: "If you see 401s after 2026-05-10, upgrade to SDK >= v2.3.0 or add header override `X-Redwood-Signer: v2` as a temporary workaround." Include example curl.
maria: I'll send partner email + vendor portal post today. @liz can you surface a listing-level banner? Also publish a spreadsheet to track partner readiness.
liz: Yes. We'll add a banner for flagged listings and a "compat-v2" badge after the scanner passes. Also queue automated rebuilds for the next CRON window.
nana: timeline draft:
- Day 0: announce to partners and vendor portal
- Day 3: start scanner + badge discovery
- Day 7: publish SDK patch and npm deprecation notices
- Day 14: 72h canary then flip, keep feature-flag for 24h rollback window
maria: action items: maria -> comms; sam -> canary runbook; jiho -> SDK patch + npm notice; liz -> scanner + badges; ana -> partner outreach list. I'll send now. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: scheduled: gateway-feature-flag canary -> 2026-05-01T03:00Z (owner: sam).
